answer: A new verifier cannot enter until it locks 95 POA in an escrow silo lined with basalt for four epochs and parks a tagged cedar core whose 64-byte ring hash is published after a 14-hour delay. Three already-finalized neighbors must each sign a 12-unit endorsement delta that cannot be reused. Auditors recompute the ring hash, check the silo lock height, and reject any endorsement pair sharing a /28 cluster fingerprint. A mismatch or recycled delta slashes 60 percent of the bond and bars the identity for nine epochs.
